name: takeScreenshot
description: Captures a PNG screenshot of the current device screen and uploads it to S3 storage, returning a pre-signed URL valid for 15 minutes. Screenshots are automatically linked to the specified traceId for later retrieval. Optionally generates a thumbnail version. Use this to visually document the app state at key moments or when encountering unexpected behavior.

traceId.description: Trace ID to associate this screenshot with. Required for organizing artifacts by test execution

includeThumb.description: Whether to also generate a thumbnail version (default: true)
